title: pauseWithdraw silently forfeits accrued rewards with no event and orphans per-share-accumulator residue
description: pauseWithdraw decrements user.amount and totalStaked but neither calls _updatePool nor settles/forfeits rewards explicitly. user.phUSDDebt and user.stableDebt are left at pre-withdraw values, and accStablePerShare retains the per-share credit that was attributable to the withdrawn portion. The bare forfeiture is acknowledged in KI-4. The downstream DoS aspect is captured by M-01; this finding captures only the residual angles: (a) no RewardsForfeited(user, phUSDAmount, stableAmount) event, and (b) orphaned accumulator residue with undefined redistribution semantics.
impact: No direct fund risk beyond the documented KI-4 forfeiture. Off-chain reconciliation cannot distinguish a 'normal' partial exit from a forfeiture event. Orphan accumulator residue implicitly enriches future entrants instead of being explicitly returned to rewardBalance — a value-allocation deviation from intent.
attackPath: user.amount and totalStaked decrement; rewardBalance unchanged; user.debt unchanged.
accStablePerShare implicitly enriches future entrants (or sits as dead weight).
likelihood: high — every pauseWithdraw call triggers this
recommendation: (a) Emit RewardsForfeited(user, phUSDAmount, stableAmount) computed from the stale debts at the moment of withdrawal. (b) Define orphan-residue semantics: either return the forfeited share to rewardBalance (and recompute rewardPerSecond), or explicitly document the redistribution-to-future-entrants behavior. Pair with the M-01 fix (rebase debts) for a consistent pauseWithdraw shape.
classifierRationale: Bare forfeiture IS KI-4; downstream DoS captured by DEDUP-002. Remaining angle (missing event + orphan-residue) is QA.
